title: Bonham, A. Private - Departure Of

page_data.en:
FORM NO. 3
B. 40M-1 38

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
C. S. 6, Special Branch. Shanghai,
REPORT
Date........July 14. 1939.

Subject (in full)........BONHAM, Private - Departure of.

Made by....D.S. Anderson........Forwarded by..D.S.I. [签名]

With reference to a teleprinter message circulated
from Central Police Station at 12.17 p.m. on 7th June 1939,
regarding a Private A.Bonham, of the East Surrey Regiment,
being missing since the 5-6-39, I have to report that, on
8th of July 1939, Private A.Bonham, departed from Shanghai
for Hongkong on board the Butterfield & Swire steamer
"Kuinchow".

The military Police of the East Surrey Regiment
and
have been communicated with/it has been ascertained that the
Private in question was duly located in Shanghai and has been
discharged from the service.

[手写批注：BPC at 9.53 am 16/7/39 to cancellation forwarded]

D.C.(Special Branch).

A.S. Anderson.
D. S.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案编号............
C. S. 6，特别处。上海，
报告
日期........1939年7月14日。

事由（全称）........二等兵邦纳姆（BONHAM）——离境。

呈报人....安德森副巡长（D.S. Anderson）........转呈人..警司 [签名]

兹就1939年6月7日下午12时17分由中央捕房发出的电传消息，关于东萨里团（East Surrey Regiment）二等兵A.邦纳姆（A.Bonham）自1939年6月5日起失踪一事，本人谨此报告：1939年7月8日，二等兵A.邦纳姆乘坐太古轮船公司（Butterfield & Swire）的“九江”号（Kuinchow）轮离开上海前往香港。

已与东萨里团的宪兵取得联系/经查证，该二等兵确在上海找到，并已退出现役。

[手写批注：1939年7月16日上午9时53分致BPC，已转发注销通知]

特别处副巡长。

A.S. 安德森。
副巡长。

[手写批注：待归档
